decision: Mappings above 0.85 confidence apply automatically; the rest wait for a person
why: Colours and sizes are low-risk; category and fit affect search and returns.
alternative: Review every mapping, or trust every mapping.
value: Five of seven fields need no one; the two risky ones get attention.

decision: Onboarding is a five-step wizard with the step in the URL
why: Sellers pause mid-way; support needs to deep-link to the step they're stuck on.
value: Resumable onboarding and shareable support links.

decision: Uploads are validated asynchronously and reported as health, not errors
why: 142 SKUs shouldn't fail because 4 lack images.
alternative: Reject the file on the first invalid row.
value: Sellers fix a short list instead of re-uploading everything.

decision: Seller fields map onto one canonical attribute model before anything goes live
why: Search facets, tax codes and size grids only work on consistent attributes.
value: Marketplace products behave like Maré products on the site.
